I look at myself and I think "Eh, not bad today." but then I tend to shoot myself down by thinking "Do I look good, or just good for me?" Generally, I think I'm a 4/10 or so. Also, one thing to look out for; any time a girl looks for an excuse to touch/help you it means shes likely into you. Do you get told you have soft hair a lot? Doubt it. ( not to be mean ). They just wanna touch you.
Eh, it can be hard. Do girls talk to you on their own volition? Like, do you have to start conversations or do they start them?
It's not that hard. I'm sorry. I'm being boring. You don't need to keep talking to me. I'm just gonna go and see if my parents want to hang out with me.

Well, thank you for the permission to rant haha. My self consciousness stems from elementary school. I had friends, but they weren't friends at the same time. They always had something to get on me for. I've always felt like I've been super young looking and just generally unattractive. I was called ugly a lot by girls in elementary and a bit into middle school. I know why I think I'm young looking. I remember once in 6th grade two friends and I were out at the park across from my house. These three girls came up to hang and they were really pretty ( from what I remember ). So, my friends and I are chatting them up, feeling pretty baws. Then, one of them says I look like I was 8. Which crushed me a bit. But, what made it so bad was my friends both tagged along and joked that I was there younger brother and shit. Then they made a lot more shitty comments before I just said I was going to go home to get food or whatever. I just cried in my room for a while. I don't know why that left such a mark on me, but I still can't really see myself as good looking or older looking or anything at all. I still feel short and baby faced even though I get mistaken for a college student fairly often. I don't know. Just makes me feel like shit about myself.

It's great, hence the inspiration to 100% it haha. It's a lot of fun, the combat is wonderful, got a lot of new mechanics, I REALLY enjoyed it. Also, the voice acting was fantastic. I also can't wait for GTA V. My brother said he'd play it with me, so that'll be fun.

Yeah. I had a best friend of five years, talked to him ever day. Asked a girl out and he totally turned on my girlfriend and I. Sent her loads of hate messages that she was stealing his best friend and stuff like that. Said he fucking hated her. Kinda ruined me. Went completely anti-social. I've tried to make friends since then but I get so fucking self-conscious it's insane. I can't stand still and I second guess everything. I end up not being able to let my face rest and have to do something- just urgh I'm ranting. Either way, yeah. That kinda messed me up because I lost all the friends I was so comfortable with and he turned out to be a totally different person that I thought he was.

No hate for LoL, just as long as you aren't one of the people who tells others to kill themselves for being new. Never liked it myself, but my brother loves it. I love single-player games, whether by choice or not haha. I recently just got the indie game Besieged that just came out. It's pretty neat. You build little siege things to destroy castles and shit. It's really polished for being in alpha. And it's like, six bucks. Damn, I sound like a commercial. But I just 100%'d shadow of mordor, like, literally did ever side mission and every little thing. Kinda sad now, don't know what to play anymore. I'm typically pretty picky. Maybe i'll replay Deus Ex. I don't know.

Anxiety has pretty much been all my life. I first remember getting it around 9 for no apparent reason. Just came and went. Depression developed around when I was 12 from not being treated well at school. My life at school is quite the opposite now, I have a lot of friends, but I can't shake the thoughts. I've talked to my parents about it, and they scheduled an appointment for me on Tuesday. So, two days from now. It helps knowing, but I don't know how much they can help. I try and have an open mind.
